newsitem.title: QATAR: Qatar awards $12.9mln GSM deal to Motorola.
newsitem.headline: Qatar awards $12.9mln GSM deal to Motorola.

text.p: Qatar's state-owned telecommunications corporation Q-Tel said on Wednesday it awarded a $12.9 million deal to Motorola Inc to upgrade and expand its global system for mobile (GSM) telephone network.
Q-Tel general manager Izzat Mohamed al-Rashid told reporters the deal included increasing cell sites inside and outside Doha to 69 from 31 now to boost reception of GSM signals.
Work is expected to be concluded within six months and would help Q-Tel increase its GSM capacity to 70,000 lines from 30,000 at present.

"Market research has shown that by 1998 mobile telephone calls will be the second highest source of revenue for the company after international calls which fetch in around 100 million riyals ($27.47 million) a year," Rashid said.
